debug_text.text: 'x4coop: cannot spawn proxy, unknown sector macro %s'.[$Args.{1}]
'x4coop: ship macro %s not available here, using fallback'.[$Args.{2}]
'x4coop: adopted %s (%s) as the partner proxy in %s'.[$Ship.idcode, $Ship.knownname, $Sector.knownname]
'x4coop: cannot warp proxy, unknown sector macro %s'.[$Args.{1}]

show_notification.text: 'Co-op: your partner is not visible yet'
'Co-op: sit in the pilot seat of an undocked ship to join your partner'
'Co-op: sit in the pilot seat of an undocked ship first'
'Co-op: guest ship %s is ready next to you. Save now and give that save to your partner.'.[$Guest.idcode]
'Co-op: could not create a guest ship here'

do_if.value: @$Obj.isclass.ship and @$Obj.sector and not Root.$AllProxies.indexof.{$Obj} and not @Root.$Adopted.indexof.{$Obj}
@$Obj.isclass.ship and @$Obj.isoperational and @$Obj.sector and not Root.$AllProxies.indexof.{$Obj} and not @Root.$Adopted.indexof.{$Obj}

check_value.value: player.age ge WeaponWatch.$NextReport and @player.target.isclass.ship and @player.target.isoperational and player.target.hasrelation.enemy.{faction.player} and @player.target.distanceto.{player.occupiedship} lt 5km

do_elseif.value: $Candidate != $Center and $Candidate.isoperational and not $Candidate.ismasstraffic and not $Candidate.isunit and not @$Candidate.dock and $Candidate.parent.isclass.space and not Root.$AllProxies.indexof.{$Candidate} and not @Root.$Adopted.indexof.{$Candidate} and not @Root.$Mirrors.indexof.{$Candidate}

$Candidate != player.occupiedship and $Candidate.isoperational and not $Candidate.ismasstraffic and not $Candidate.isunit and not @$Candidate.dock and $Candidate.parent.isclass.space and not Root.$AllProxies.indexof.{$Candidate} and not @Root.$Adopted.indexof.{$Candidate} and not @Root.$Mirrors.indexof.{$Candidate}

do_if.value: not $Own and $Candidate.idcode == $Args.{1} and $Candidate != player.occupiedship and not @$Candidate.dock and $Candidate.parent.isclass.space and not $Candidate.ismasstraffic and not Root.$AllProxies.indexof.{$Candidate} and not @Root.$Adopted.indexof.{$Candidate} and not Root.$Mirrors.indexof.{$Candidate}
@$Seller.isclass.ship and $Seller.isplayerowned and $Seller != player.occupiedship and not @$Seller.commander.isclass.station and @Root.$EmpireShips.indexof.{$Seller}
@$Buyer.isclass.ship and $Buyer.isplayerowned and $Buyer != player.occupiedship and not @$Buyer.commander.isclass.station and @Root.$EmpireShips.indexof.{$Buyer}
@$Seller.isclass.ship and $Seller.isplayerowned and ($Seller == player.occupiedship or not @Root.$EmpireShips.indexof.{$Seller}) and @$Buyer.isclass.station

do_elseif.value: @$Buyer.isclass.ship and $Buyer.isplayerowned and ($Buyer == player.occupiedship or not @Root.$EmpireShips.indexof.{$Buyer}) and @$Seller.isclass.station

do_if.value: $Faction and $Faction != faction.player and ($Faction.relationto.{faction.player} - $Value gt 0.0001 or $Faction.relationto.{faction.player} - $Value lt -0.0001)

set_value.name: $Other
set_value.exact: if event.param == faction.player then event.param2 else event.param

do_if.value: Root.$SyncedRelation? and Root.$SyncedRelation.{$Other}? and $New - Root.$SyncedRelation.{$Other} lt 0.0001 and $New - Root.$SyncedRelation.{$Other} gt -0.0001

do_elseif.value: $Reason == relationchangereason.missioncompleted or $Reason == relationchangereason.missionfailed or $Reason == relationchangereason.smalltalkreward or $Reason == relationchangereason.scanningdiscovered or $Reason == relationchangereason.hackingdiscovered or $Reason == relationchangereason.illegalcargo or $Reason == relationchangereason.illegalplot
Root.$Blame? and Root.$Blame.{$Other}? and player.age - Root.$Blame.{$Other} lt 3s

set_value.name: $Report
set_value.exact: if event.param2 then ['b', event.param2.id, 'w'] else ['b', event.param.id, 'm']

set_value.name: $Followed
set_value.exact: if Root.$WarpFollowUntil? and player.age lt Root.$WarpFollowUntil then 1 else 0

check_value.value: @Root.$OwnersOn == 1 and @event.param.isclass.ship and (event.param2 == faction.player or event.param3 == faction.player)

do_elseif.value: @$Ship.sector and event.param2 and not Root.$AllProxies.indexof.{$Ship} and not @Root.$Adopted.indexof.{$Ship} and not @Root.$Mirrors.indexof.{$Ship}

check_value.value: not player.entity.$x4coop_shared_at? or not @event.param2.time or event.param2.time ge player.entity.$x4coop_shared_at * 1s

show_notification.text: 'Co-op: the station your partner is on is not in your world'
'Co-op: sit in the pilot seat of an undocked ship to join your partner'
'Co-op: you are at ' + $Container.knownname + ', where your partner is on foot'

check_value.value: not player.entity.$x4coop_shared_at? or not @event.param3.time or event.param3.time ge player.entity.$x4coop_shared_at * 1s

set_value.name: $Assignments
set_value.exact: [assignment.defence, assignment.attack, assignment.interception, assignment.bombardment, assignment.positiondefence, assignment.assist, assignment.mining, assignment.trade, assignment.build, assignment.supplyfleet, assignment.tradeforbuildstorage, assignment.salvage, assignment.prospect, assignment.follow, assignment.police, assignment.watchdog]

check_value.value: @Root.$EmpireOn == 1 and event.object.isoperational and event.object.isaccountholder and not event.object.isclass.buildstorage and event.param2 and (event.object.maxbudget ge 0Cr)

set_value.name: $Faction
set_value.exact: if $M.{5} != '' and @faction.{$M.{5}} then faction.{$M.{5}} else faction.player

set_value.name: $ObjOk
set_value.exact: @$Obj.isoperational and $Obj.isclass.ship and $Obj != player.occupiedship and not Root.$AllProxies.indexof.{$Obj} and not @Root.$Adopted.indexof.{$Obj}

do_if.value: @$Ship.isclass.ship and $Ship.isplayerowned and @$Ship.sector and not @Root.$AllProxies.indexof.{$Ship} and not (@CommandWatch.$Quiet.{$Ship} gt player.age)
not $Target and $Candidate.idcode == $Args.{1} and $Candidate != player.occupiedship and not Root.$AllProxies.indexof.{$Candidate} and not @Root.$Adopted.indexof.{$Candidate}
